**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of KAT6B and PAX3 in neural crest development could reveal common therapeutic targets for addressing the diverse phenotypes of genitopatellar syndrome and Waardenburg syndrome type 1, potentially focusing on modulating neural crest cell biology or related signaling pathways.
